item.title: Louisiana moms charged for exposing kids to narcotics
item.description: Two mothers in Louisiana have been arrested after being accused of providing their children with illegal narcotics.

item.title: Part-time Pointe Coupee Parish deputy placed on leave amid investigation
item.description: The Pointe Coupee Parish Sheriff's Office confirmed that a part-time deputy was placed on administrative leave.

item.title: Louisiana bill targets fraud related to benefits for children
item.description: A Louisiana legislator has filed a bill that would crack down on fraud related to public assistance benefits for children.

item.title: Former Human Jukebox member returns as arranger for Southern University band
item.description: Jaron "Bear" Williams, a New Orleans native and former member of the Southern University Human Jukebox Marching Band, has been appointed as an arranger for the band.

item.title: Novo Nordisk slashing prices for weight-loss and diabetes drugs Ozempic, Wegovy and Rybelsus
item.description: Novo Nordisk announced Tuesday it will be slashing the list price of its blockbuster GLP-1 medications, Ozempic, Wegovy and Rybelsus, by up to 50 percent beginning next year.

item.title: Report: Julia Letlow scrutinized for delayed stock trade reports
item.description: Congresswoman Julia Letlow failed to report 210 individual stock trades on time over the past two years as federal law requires, according to a report.

item.title: Port Allen police issue arrest warrant for Baton Rouge man accused of contractor fraud
item.description: The Port Allen Police Department is seeking the public's help in locating Austin Pooler of Baton Rouge, who is accused of contractor fraud over $5,000 but under $25,000 for failing to perform the work he was contracted to do.

item.title: Louisiana moves to safeguard federal benefits for foster children
item.description: Louisiana is taking action to strengthen the foster care system and protect benefits for eligible children.
